newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals seen opening slightly weaker.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals seen opening slightly weaker.

text.p: New York precious metals futures were called to open slightly lower Thursday, after seeing some choppy action on light volumes earlier this week before the New Year holiday Wednesday.
COMEX February gold was called to open unchanged to down 30 cents from Tuesday's close at $369.00 an ounce. The after hours electronic ACCESS system was closed overnight for the New Year holiday.
Spot gold in the bullion market was quoted early at $367.70/368.10, after gold fixed at a four week low at $367.80 in London Thursday morning.
COMEX warehouse gold stocks were unchanged at 666,165 ounces Tuesday.
COMEX March silver was seen opening unchanged to down 0.20 cent an ounce from Tuesday's close at $4.790 an ounce, with silver fixing in London Thursday morning at $4.770 an ounce.
COMEX silver stocks fell 588,522 ounces to 145,814,454 ounces Tuesday.

NYMEX April platinum was seen opening unchanged to down 50 cents an ounce from the previous close at $374.50, while NYMEX March palladium was called to open unchanged to down $1.00 an ounce, after jumping sharply Tuesday.
